name: @cnmw/format-shapefile
description: Shapefile output for @cnmw/download-core: a zero-dependency, zero-wasm .shp/.shx/.dbf/.prj/.cpg writer bundled into one .shp.zip, with Shapefile's real limits (10-char field names, one shape type per file, ~2GiB size) surfaced as warnings instead of silent mangling.
